pages.title: About Us
pages.page_body:
CarePlus is a 150-bed NABH accredited hospital offering 24×7 emergency care, advanced surgery and preventive health programs.

Our story

CarePlus Multispeciality Hospital started with a simple idea: compassionate care, advanced medicine. Today a passionate team carries that promise forward every day.

What we believe

  • People first
  • Quality without shortcuts
  • Honest, transparent communication

pages.title: Privacy Policy
pages.page_body:
CarePlus Multispeciality Hospital respects your privacy. We collect only the information you share with us through our forms, use it only to respond to you, and never sell it.

Contact us anytime to view or delete your data.

pages.title: Terms of Use
pages.page_body: By using the CarePlus Multispeciality Hospital website you agree to use it lawfully. Content is for general information and may change without notice.
